cards.subject: Constellas
lines: A night elf settlement in the forest belt below Hyjal. What survives is broken architecture and a moonwell.
The moonwell is still there and still working. It is just full of fel now. Go and look into it — it is the clearest before and after in the zone.

cards.subject: It was done before Hyjal, not after
lines: Archimonde ordered Felwood corrupted to weaken the night elf defences ahead of the assault on the mountain. Tichondrius carried it out with the Skull of Gul'dan.
The forest was killed as a tactic.
Illidan then took the Skull from him, and Malfurion banished him for it. Illidan's fall starts here.

cards.subject: The colour of the air
cards.tag: You will know at the border
lines: This is the zone people describe by its light — a sick olive haze sitting over everything that never lifts.
It is the only zone whose corruption is legible before you read a single quest.
You know the moment you cross out of Ashenvale.

cards.subject: Shatter Scar Vale
lines: Infernals were dropped here during the Third War, and the holes they made are still smouldering.
The demons still walking around in them are elite in here.
They were only made non-elite years later. This is not a solo stroll.

cards.subject: Kroshius
lines: He lies in the mountains above the vale, and he drops Kroshius' Infernal Core.
That core is the warlock quest item for learning to summon an Infernal.
Every warlock in this game with an Infernal came to Felwood for it.

cards.subject: Jaedenar
lines: The Shadow Council named their town in worship of Kil'jaeden. Very few places in this world are named for a demon lord by the people living in them.
Shadow Hold is built into ancient night elf ruins and two druidic barrow dens.
The cult moved into a place where druids used to sleep.

cards.subject: A dreadlord lives at the bottom
lines: Lord Banehollow commands Jaedenar from inside — one of very few nathrezim standing in the open world at all.
His warlocks are orcs and Forsaken, not demons, and their work is pushing the corruption east into Ashenvale.
Felwood is not finished. It is a front line still moving.

cards.subject: It is not the Cenarion Circle
lines: Everyone calls the southeastern camp the Cenarion camp. The druids holding it are the Emerald Circle — night elves, tauren and furbolg together.
Every one of them was deleted from the game in 4.0.3a.
They exist here and nowhere else.

cards.subject: Every plant has two versions
lines: Corrupt Whipper Root, Night Dragon's Breath and Songflower stand all over the zone, and a salve turns each into its clean twin.
A cleansed whipper root gives you tubers that heal for over a thousand and do not share the potion cooldown.
The whole zone is a slow healing-item farm disguised as an ecology.

cards.subject: One flower buffs everybody
lines: Fifteen to all attributes and five percent crit, for an hour.
More than one player can take it off the same flower.
A raid on its way to Blackwing Lair could stop in a poisoned forest and all pick up the same bloom.

cards.subject: Felcloth
lines: Every other cloth in the game comes off humanoids. This one comes off demons.
Tailors purify it into Mooncloth.
The corrupt thing gets carried out through the Timbermaw tunnel and made clean on the other side.

cards.subject: Three Ancients, petrified
lines: Vartrus, Stoma and Hastat — great living trees of the night elves, standing in the north of the zone, turned to stone.
The rest of Irontree is crazed treants and corrupted elementals.
The three of them are the only things up there that were ever on your side.

cards.subject: Timbermaw Hold
lines: The tunnel is the only ground link between Felwood, Winterspring and Moonglade, and friendly standing buys you passage.
You start Hostile, and you have to reach Neutral before anyone will take a totem off you at all.
They attack strangers because they are afraid you are one of their corrupted brothers.
